#### **1. Who Said What (Sort by Date & Time)**

- Provided details about the study: four assessments per day and an evening survey for one week.

- **[Karen Ollrogge] (M.Sc. Psychologie, Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin) – [October 24, 2024]:**

- Sent invoice #1561 and requested additional project details (start/end dates, project description).

- **[Sara Farnya] (Role not specified) – [October 24, 2024]:**

- Advised Maryam to contact Karen for the remaining information.
